icons:doc.description: This command parses the icons folder to document them in their files

icons:bundle.description: This command bundles icon and public asset content into generated modules for the Worker to import (no runtime filesystem access)

deploy.command: rm -rf dist && deno run -A npm:wrangler@4.128.0 deploy main.tsx --config=wrangler.worker.jsonc --dry-run --outdir=dist && mv dist/main.js dist/_worker.js && rm -f dist/main.js.map dist/README.md && deno run -A npm:wrangler@4.128.0 pages deploy dist --project-name=picto --no-bundle
deploy.description: Bundles main.tsx into dist/_worker.js and deploys it to Cloudflare Pages
